lines: Via the efforts of mercenaries, especially Sakura's efforts, the drones were getting taken down one by one.
And when finally about half of the drones had been disabledー
Show them what you can do, Faust-san!!
All the mercenaries' gazes converged on Faust.
Faust jumped directly into the enemy formation and wildly fired her two large custom handguns.
The drones had no time to return fire and were helplessly knocked to the ground.
Wh-Whoa there... that mechanical woman is ridiculous...
It was no ordinary destructive power. To go along with her body that was like a reinforced cyborg, those handguns must have also had some insane modifications as well.
Oooh~ awesome... Alright!! I won't be outdone!!
Sakura approached a drone in the blink of an eyeー
And she gave one quick punch to the drone's weak spot and then quickly withdrew. She repeated that until she had made drone after drone into scrap metal.
Ahaha! Little girl! Impressive skills for someone who's mere flesh and blood!
Wait!? You can speak like a human!?
It's an act. Sometimes it's easier to pretend to be a machine!
What the heck, you invented a character?!
Little girlー Wait, tell me your name.
Sakura, let's cut to the center of the enemy formation.
As Faust and Sakura barged ahead, the mercenary troops continued their heavy offensive.
The enemy drone squad had been routed and all that was left was to take out the stragglers.
I had quietly snuck onto one of the transport trucks. A crate with the "cargo" in it was looming in front of me in the darkness.
The crate opened unexpectedly easily. And inside itー
